perbandinganUmum.q1: Building A is 120 meters tall and Building B is 150 meters tall. Find the ratio of Building B's height to Building A's height in its simplest form!
perbandinganUmum.q2: A fruit basket contains 24 red apples and 16 green apples. What is the ratio of red apples to the total number of apples in the basket (express in simplest form)?
perbandinganUmum.q3: Father's current age is 45 years old and Budi's age is 15 years old. Find the ratio of Father's age to Budi's age 5 years ago!
perbandinganUmum.q4: The distance from Ali's house to school is 2.5 km, while the distance from Cici's house to school is only 500 meters. What is the ratio of the distance from Ali's house to Cici's house to school in its simplest form?

perbandinganUmum.q6: A large water bottle contains 1.5 liters of water. The water is poured into a glass with a capacity of 300 ml. What is the ratio of the volume of water in the large bottle to the glass?

perbandinganSenilai.title: DIRECT AND INVERSE PROPORTION
perbandinganSenilai.instruction: Solve the following problems, showing all your work

q1.intro: For each of the following statements, determine whether it represents a direct proportion, an inverse proportion, or neither!
q1.a: The average speed of a car and the travel time needed to reach the destination city.
q1.b: The number of servings in a cake recipe and the amount of flour (in grams) required.
q1.c: A person's age and their shoe size.
q1.d: The distance traveled by a taxi and the total fare the passenger must pay.
q1.e: The number of pages in a novel and the time needed to read it from start to finish.
q1.f: The number of water pumps running and the time needed to empty a swimming pool.
q1.g: The number of siblings a student has and their mathematics exam score.
q1.h: The flow rate of water from a tap and the volume of water collected in a bucket over a given time.

perbandinganSenilai.q2: A car needs 4 liters of gasoline to travel 60 km. If the car is filled with 10 liters of gasoline, find the maximum distance the car can travel!
perbandinganSenilai.q3: A farmer has enough livestock feed for 30 cows for 15 days. If the farmer just bought 15 more cows, how many days will the feed supply last?
perbandinganSenilai.q4: A digital photo printing machine needs 5 minutes to print 60 high-resolution photos. How many minutes will the machine need to print an order of 84 photos?
perbandinganSenilai.q5: An animal shelter has enough dry food for 20 cats for 25 days. How many days will the food supply last if the shelter receives 5 more cats?
perbandinganSenilai.q6: Adi can finish a certain job in 4 hours. Budi can finish the same job in 6 hours. If Adi and Budi work on the job together, how long will it take them to finish?
perbandinganSenilai.q7: Machine P can fill a tank completely in 2 hours, machine Q in 5 hours, and machine R in 10 hours. If all three machines are turned on at the same time, how long will it take to fill the tank completely?
perbandinganSenilai.q8: Setting up a cultural festival stage is estimated to take 24 days if done by 6 technicians. After 4 days of work, operations were halted for 8 days due to a storm. How many additional technicians are needed so the stage is ready on the original schedule?
perbandinganSenilai.q9: A school uniform order can be completed by 4 tailors in 20 days. After they worked for 4 days, a power outage stopped all work for 12 days. How many additional tailors are needed to complete the order on time?
perbandinganSenilai.q10: A large wedding catering order would take 3 head chefs 10 days, or 8 kitchen assistants 9 days to complete. If the order is worked on together by 5 head chefs and 6 kitchen assistants, how many days will it take to complete?

perbandinganSkala.title: SCALE
perbandinganSkala.instruction: Solve the following problems, showing all your work

q1.stem: The meaning of a map scale of 1 : 500,000 is...
q1.optA: A. 1 cm on the map represents 500,000 cm of actual distance.
q1.optB: B. 1 cm on the map represents 500,000 km of actual distance.
q1.optC: C. 1 km on the map represents 500,000 cm of actual distance.
q1.optD: D. 500,000 cm on the map represents 1 cm of actual distance.

q2.stem: Map of region X has a scale of 1 : 50,000. Map of region Y has a scale of 1 : 250,000. The correct statement about these two maps is...
q2.optA: A. Map X shows a larger area with less detail than map Y.
q2.optB: B. One centimeter on map X represents a greater real distance than on map Y.
q2.optC: C. Both maps have the same level of detail.
q2.optD: D. Map X is more detailed than map Y for the same paper size.

q3.stem: The distance between two cities on a map is 20 cm. If the map scale is 1 : 600,000, the actual distance between the two cities is...

q4.stem: The actual distance between city A and city B is 120 km. If the distance on the map is 6 cm, what is the map's scale?

q5.stem: A garden on a floor plan measures 12 cm × 15 cm. If the actual size of the garden is 50 m × 40 m, the scale used is....

q6.stem: The actual distance between two buildings is 4.5 km. If the buildings are drawn on a floor plan using a scale of 1 : 15,000, the distance on the floor plan is...

q7.stemIntro: Look at the following house floor plan!
q7.stem: If the floor plan scale is 1 : 200, the actual area of the house is ...

q8.stemPre: A building floor plan has a scale of 1 : 300. If the floor plan area is 125 cm
q8.stemPost: , the actual area of the building is ...

q9.stem: The distance between two cities on a map with a scale of 1 : 1,200,000 is 5 cm. Andi travels from city A to city B by motorbike at an average speed of 40 km/h. If he departs at 07:15 and rests for 30 minutes along the way, what time will he arrive at city B?

q10.stem: A property company builds a scale model (3D miniature) of an apartment building at a scale of 1 : 100. If the swimming pool in the model holds 2 liters of water when full, what is the actual water capacity of the swimming pool?

tentang.subtitle: Active Numeracy with Information and Communication Technology
tentang.desc1: <boldPrimary>NUMATIK</boldPrimary> stands for <boldAccent>Nu</boldAccent>meracy <boldAccent>A</boldAccent>ctively with <boldAccent>T</boldAccent>echnology of <boldAccent>I</boldAccent>nformation and <boldAccent>K</boldAccent>nowledge — a mathematics education application specifically designed to bridge learning challenges in the digital era. Born from a passion for delivering learning that is not only informative, but also <boldAccent>meaningful and enjoyable</boldAccent>.
tentang.desc2: First launched in <boldPrimary>2026</boldPrimary>, Numatik was developed fully aligned with the <boldAccent>Merdeka Curriculum</boldAccent>. The app integrates a <boldSecondary>Deep Learning</boldSecondary> approach to ensure students don't merely memorize formulas, but understand concepts deeply, critically, and contextually.
tentang.desc3: Numatik is prepared to be a learning companion for all junior high school students around the world.
tentang.desktopDesc: Open <link>www.numatik.app</link> on your laptop or PC for a wider display and a better learning experience.
tentang.copyright: Eighth Edition · © 2026 NUMATIK. All rights reserved.

biografi.pesanSubtitle: 🌍 To All Students Around the World
biografi.pesanIsi: "Hello, amazing students around the world! I designed this app especially to make mathematics feel more approachable and friendly for all of you. Remember — no one is ever 'bad' at math; there are only those who haven't practiced enough yet. Happy exploring, and don't be afraid to make mistakes — because mistakes are how we truly learn!"

kelompokA2.paragraf1: My deepest gratitude goes to <orange>Kelompok A2 Guru Penggerak Angkatan 10</orange> — an extraordinary group that became the <amber>very first spark of inspiration</amber> behind the creation of NUMATIK.
kelompokA2.kutipan: "From one small group brimming with passion and purpose, an app was born — with the hope of inspiring thousands of learners."
kelompokA2.footer: THANK YOU, KELOMPOK A2 GURU PENGGERAK ANGKATAN 10

wandri.paragraf1: My sincerest gratitude goes to <cyan>Bapak Wandri, S.Pd., Gr.</cyan> — a colleague and mentor who, with wholehearted dedication, patience, and generosity, opened up a whole new world of knowledge in <accent>Information and Communication Technology</accent>.
wandri.paragraf2: He patiently taught me <cyan>coding</cyan> from scratch, and played a pivotal role in laying down and building the <accent>initial framework of NUMATIK</accent> — the very foundation that still supports this app today.
wandri.paragraf3: The knowledge, insights, and spirit he shared are the very pillars upon which <primary>NUMATIK</primary> was built.
wandri.kutipan: "A true teacher is not only one who imparts knowledge, but one who ignites the flame of passion within their students."
wandri.footer: THANK YOU SO MUCH, PAK WANDRI
